name: Terminus Network Services
summary: Small Perth ISP and open-source IT firm founded and run by Jeremy Malcolm (manager/MD 1998-2005); internet connectivity, web design, consultancy, training and networking solutions based on Debian/open-source software; ~3 staff; defunct by mid-2000s (LINUX CONSULTANTS PTY LTD, ACN 083 643 556).

events.details: Established 1998 by Jeremy Malcolm (Perth); earliest Wayback capture of terminus.net.au Aug 2000.
Website gone (no live site) — Terminus Network Services became AssureTek.

refs.label: Site announces the rebrand/pivot to AssureTek by May 2008.
